cases.manifest:
manifest_version = 1
id = "dev.kinetix.antigravity-oauth"
name = "Antigravity OAuth"
version = "0.1.14"
plugin_api = "3"

# Antigravity accounts are provisioned by a host-managed refresh-token exchange
# (§6.1). The plugin reads the account's OAuth JSON, refreshes the access token
# against Google, and returns an opaque lease; the live token is written to the
# plugin's encrypted KV and injected host-side at send time.

[provides]
credential_strategies = ["antigravity-oauth"]
auth_flows = ["antigravity"]
account_model_sources = ["antigravity-models"]
provider_adapters = ["antigravity"]
health_probes = ["antigravity-oauth"]
thinking_translation = true

[[integrations]]
id = "antigravity"
name = "Google Antigravity"
description = "Connect a Google Antigravity account and use the v1internal model API."
provider_adapter = "antigravity"
credential_strategy = "antigravity-oauth"
auth_flow = "antigravity"
credential_mode = "auth_flow"
model_source = "antigravity-models"

[integrations.features]
schema_version = 1
streaming = true
tools = true
parallel_tools = true
vision = true
reasoning = true
structured_output = false
model_discovery = true
quota_probe = false
health_probe = false

[integrations.protocols]
input = ["openai-chat", "openai-responses", "anthropic"]
upstream = ["plugin-native"]

[integrations.provider]
base_url = "https://daily-cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com"
wire_format = "plugin"
auth_scheme = "bearer"
timeout_ms = 120000
capability_mode = "permissive"
follow_redirects = false

[[ui.settings]]
key = "login_hint"
label = "Google account hint"
kind = "text"
description = "Optional email address shown as Google's login hint during account authorization."

[[ui.actions]]
id = "connect-account"
label = "Connect account"
kind = "auth"
integration = "antigravity"
description = "Sign in with Google and add an Antigravity account to a bound provider."

[permissions]
# Browser authorization is host-validated; token exchange and userinfo are
# performed through host-mediated buffered HTTP.
network_hosts = ["accounts.google.com", "oauth2.googleapis.com", "www.googleapis.com", "cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com", "daily-cloudcode-pa.googleapis.com"]
credential_scopes = ["credential_strategy:antigravity-oauth"]
# The refresh_token exchange puts the secret in a POST body, which the opaque
# handle model cannot express, so this plugin requires plaintext credential
# read (§8.2). It is a materially higher-risk grant and is flagged on install.
credential_read = true

[limits]
memory = "64MiB"
wall_time_ms = 30000
max_outbound_requests = 6
max_http_body = "1MiB"
storage = "1MiB"

[integrations.install.account]
name = "Example account"

[[integrations.install.routes]]
id = "example"
model = "gemini-2.5-pro"
cases.name: proposed-antigravity-oauth
